notes.title: Update notes for v1.0.4 (16/09/25)
notes.content:
Another quick update with a few improvements based on the feedback.

[list]
[*] The rounds no longer end when you run out of actions if you still have mods that can be applied, to allow for more clutch plays!
[*] Added an option to minimise the game over panel so you can take screenshots or check to see what you could have done differently
[*] Made the text indicators and animation when a token triggers a bit more prominent, as well as adding a sound effect
[*] Added a bit more fanfare when you complete a round
[/list]

I really appreciate all the feedback and I'm keen to do what I can to make this game the best it can be, so please do reach out if you have complaints or suggestions! Reviews are also hugely appreciated!

Happy Mining,
Wayne

notes.title: Update notes for v1.0.3 (20/08/25)
notes.content: Just a quick update to fix the formatting on some the tips in the Chinese translations.

notes.title: Update notes for v1.0.2 (14/08/25)
notes.content:
Just a few quick updates to address some of the early feedback.

[list]
[*] Added a 'new game' button to the pause menu
[*] Added a button (top right, next to the pause/options button) that opens a 'reel slots' view that lets you see the contents of your reels
[*] Added a couple of extra contextual tutorial messages
[*] Added 'tips' to the value setting screen, but I didn't want to make it too hand-holdy so some of them are just useless fluff
[*] Charge mods now stack, you can have up to 9 charge on a single slot.
[/list]

Let me know if you spot anything that looks broken or if you have more suggestions for improvements!

Happy Mining,
Wayne
